I use **Wolfram Mathematica** for symbolic and numerical work in mathematical physics. This page will host a curated selection of **self-contained notebooks** that I expressly choose to make public.

## Teaching demonstrations

Explanatory notebooks accompanying lecture notes or problem sessions can be listed here with the course, level, version and usage conditions. **No teaching notebooks are available for download yet.**

## Scientific and computational examples

Selected demonstrations related to spectral problems, scattering theory and quantum-vacuum calculations may be shared when they concern public, fully disclosed results. Research working files, unpublished algorithms and confidential numerical investigations are **not published by default**.

## Information accompanying each notebook

Every released file will identify its author(s), version and date, required Mathematica version, relevant scientific reference (where appropriate), and **its individual copyright or software licence**. Viewing this page does not grant access to, or permission to reuse, unshared source code.

For questions about permitted uses, consult [Copyright & licensing](copyright.qmd) or [contact me](contact.qmd).
